description: This file defines the JwtTokenGenerator class, which implements token creation logic for security purposes, specifically generating JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) for a user authentication system.

classes.name: JwtTokenGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating JWT tokens based on issuer options and user credentials.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT for a given username, embedding claims such as subject, token ID, and issued at timestamp, and then signs it.
